name: Mezzo Pollo Academy
pitch: A plush half-chicken runs three lanes and must pass under the gate with the right half: numbers, words and mirrored shapes. When the WHOLE CHICKEN flies over, don't move.
access: Free public reviewer demo: https://mezzopollo.it/practice. No wallet or tokens; exactly 2 lives per new game, no refill on pause/resume, separate local unverified record. The main game at / requires at least 1,000,000 MEMEZZO (1000000000000 raw, six decimals) summed across active DevFridge locks of the same connected Phantom wallet and Solana mainnet mint Dv1prgxPZs1M6vpacCzmGjLkd7ZFZVJSHCH9PLwEpump, program 9RY54dNPYTzDyh3TfFqDdt2b2KMM56KW1tw9erRTGQo6. No minimum original or remaining duration; unlockAt must be in the future. Each main run starts with floor(active MEMEZZO / 1,000,000) total lives, no base lives: 1m gives 1, 1.999999m gives 1, 2m gives 2. Refresh/resume never refills lives; above-threshold changes apply next run. Lost eligibility, disconnect, stale evidence or errors pause and block continuation until fresh qualifying evidence returns for the same wallet; switching wallets requires a new run. Browser-side checks, no server authentication or verified scores. The game reads locks and requests no signatures/transactions. Locks are created/redeemed externally on DevFridge: no early withdrawal, 2% redemption fee for PASTA buy-and-burn plus network costs; MEMEZZO redemption needs an executable Jupiter route. Wallet features for adults.
limitations: Static Three.js r128 prototype. Access, lives and local scores are browser-side; no server-authenticated sessions, leaderboard, rewards or multiplayer. The free 2-life reviewer demo is public and does not verify reviewer identity or load the wallet controller. Italy/United States/Poland flags select Italian/English/Polish, including 40 native word targets each; country is a language preference, not location/access evidence. The free-demo revision passed 32 local browser checks (natural 2-to-0 game over, pause/restart, score separation, no wallet/API, main gate and synthetic 1m case); 43 access unit tests passed. Prior locale, access and caption verification is documented in VERIFICATION.md. Wallet/lock tests use explicit synthetic fixtures and mobile viewport emulation, not physical Phantom approval, mainnet transactions or physical devices. No screen-lock or sustained-performance certification. SDK caching or upstream RPC failure can leave sufficient locks unconfirmed and deny main-game access. Procedural art/SFX; Google Lyria soundtrack with documented provenance and approximate English subtitles. Media at /demo includes silent English walkthroughs that visibly disclose simulated wallet evidence; these are separate from the live free demo. Three.js MIT; Google Fonts SIL OFL. Gallery review does not establish competition eligibility.
